messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — prelaunch checklist for Wed webinar. Need a small SEO task list: landing page schema, guestlist CTA redirect mapping, canonical + UTM plan. Quick sync?

Kevin Patel: I can own the redirect map. will draft redirect rules and a tiny rollback plan.

Samir Rao: I’ll do schema/structured data + OG/Twitter card copy. any mandatory fields for compliance?

Elaine Park: Can we reuse keywords from the benchmark narrative? that doc had top intents + 3 target KW groups. I’ll pull them into meta drafts.

Gaurav Singh: Question — are we gating the guestlist behind an email capture? currently we have /guestlist (light gate) and /register (full form). which one gets the canonical?

Maria Chen: Good call. plan: /guestlist is marketing soft-gate (light capture), /register is full attendee flow. canonical should be /register for main event pages; /guestlist should canonical-> /register only if content duplicates. otherwise canonical self.

Kevin Patel: Draft redirect rules (first pass):
```
# Redirect map for social posts + launch emails
/webinar/guestlist -> /guestlist?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=prelaunch  302
/guestlist -> /register?utm_source=guestlist-form&utm_campaign=webinar  302  # after submit, server should move to /register-confirm
/webinar/2026-launch -> /register?utm_source=launch-archive&utm_campaign=webinar 301
```
Notes: prefer 302 for short-term campaign redirects, 301 for content moves. rollback: point /guestlist back to landing after launch.

Samir Rao: Schema draft — Event + HowTo for agenda crumbs. Minimum: name, startDate, endDate, location (online), url, offers (price free), performer (speakers array). Also add registrationType = "online" and sameAs for organizer. Example snippet I’ll attach to PR.

Elaine Park: Keywords to use (from benchmark):
- webinar benchmarking (high intent)
- ai inference platform cost (mid intent)
- inference latency best practices (informational)
Will write meta desc variations for A/B.

Gaurav Singh: On internal linking — put a persistent CTA in docs hub + product page to /guestlist with rel="noopener" and campaign params. Also add a sitewide tiny banner for 72 hours.

Maria Chen: Action items:
- Kevin: create redirect PR and cidr-safe nginx rules by Mon EOD (owner)
- Samir: open PR for schema + OG tags, include sample JSON-LD and tests (owner)
- Elaine: meta copy + 3 KW sets, publish to content repo (owner)
- Gaurav: banner + doc link additions + tracking plan (owner)
I’ll coordinate with demand team for UTM matrix.

Kevin Patel: @seo-bot can we run a staging crawl once PRs are up? don’t want orphaned internal links.

seo-bot: staging-crawl scheduled for 2026-04-01T02:00Z. Will post crawl errors to #marketing-crawl-results.

Samir Rao: small example JSON-LD I’ll use in PR:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Production Inference Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T16:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-04-07T17:00:00Z",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "eventAttendanceMode": "https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://www.redwood.com/register"},
  "offers": {"@type": "Offer", "url": "https://www.redwood.com/register", "price": "0", "priceCurrency": "USD"}
}
```
(Will also include FAQ markup under the webinar page to surface in SERPs.)

Elaine Park: I’ll drop the 3 meta variations into the content doc and ping growth for a quick preference vote.

Maria Chen: Great — let’s reconvene Tue 9am to verify PRs and staging crawl. If anyone hits blockers ping here. :thumbsup:

Kevin Patel: on it. starting PR now.

Samir Rao: will include unit test for JSON-LD presence.

Gaurav Singh: tracking plan: add utm_content for variant, utm_term for keyword cluster. set event tag in GA4 and a segment for guestlist -> register conversions.

Maria Chen: perfect. closing loop — thanks team!
